sections.title: Store & availability
fields: Individual, proprietorship, partnership or company. Business name and contact details are reused from your partner profile.
Completed years; zero is allowed for a new store.
Include street, city, state and PIN code. Reuse the profile address if it is the same.
Provide a map link to the store, not a customer's location.
Include closing times, weekly holidays and pickup hours.
State in-store shopping, pickup, delivery or a combination. Explain pickup instructions and own/third-party delivery arrangements.

sections.title: Delivery & order limits
fields: List areas served or enter Pickup/in-store only if delivery is unavailable.
Enter zero if there is no minimum.
Give available slots, preparation time and order cutoff; enter Not applicable if delivery is unavailable.

sections.title: Products & pricing arrangements
fields: List the main categories and brands you stock. Product names, descriptions, photos and current availability belong in the catalogue.
Examples: piece, packet, kilogram, litre, bag or carton; include loose versus packaged options.
Pricing, minimum quantities and bulk discounts
Describe minimum quantities, quantity discounts, packaging charges and tax treatment. Maintain item selling prices and applicable MRP in the catalogue.
Explain stock-update frequency and how customers approve substitutions. Do not substitute without their consent.

sections.title: Storage, quality & food safety
fields: Explain supplier checks, purchase records and how affected batches can be identified.
Describe date checks, stock rotation and removal of expired or damaged products.
Describe storage conditions, cleaning routines and pest-control arrangements.
Describe chilled/frozen storage and delivery controls, or enter Not sold.
Describe hygienic handling, food-safe packaging, labels and allergen/cross-contact information where relevant.
Explain quantity checks and applicable equipment verification; enter Packaged goods only if relevant.
Explain isolation, sale prevention, customer contact and return/disposal arrangements.

sections.title: Registration & evidence
fields: Provide the applicable reference and category. If not applicable, state why; applicability is subject to review.
Enter the expiry date where the registration has one.
List trade/business registration, weighing verification, or brand/distributor authorisation as applicable. Reuse tax registration already supplied in your profile.
Identify the documents uploaded: applicable food/trade registration, store photos, catalogue, supplier evidence and relevant organic certification. Reuse existing profile documents.

sections.title: Orders, returns & complaints
fields: Explain confirmation, unavailable items, customer-approved substitutions and price changes.
Describe collection windows, failed deliveries, redelivery charges and who to contact.
State cancellation deadlines, perishable-item conditions and refund timelines without excluding applicable customer rights.
Missing, incorrect, damaged or expired goods
Provide the reporting process, reasonable evidence, review times and replacement/refund remedies. Include bulk shortages and damage claims where applicable.

Supermarket: List departments, fresh/chilled/frozen ranges, cold storage and home-delivery facilities.
Provision Store: Describe daily essentials, loose/packaged goods, local delivery and recurring household orders.
Organic Store: Identify products sold as organic, supporting certification or supplier evidence, traceability and separation from conventional goods. Upload relevant evidence.
Wholesale Grocery: Describe categories, minimum quantities, carton sizes, price tiers, business-customer requirements, dispatch capacity and payment/credit terms if offered.
Rice & Grain Shop: List varieties, grades, origin where known, loose/bagged options, bag sizes, cleaning/milling availability and bulk capacity.
